metadata.title: Ricci-pinched 3-Manifolds with second-fundamental-form-pinched Boundary
metadata.abstract: We prove a boundary analogue of the rigidity theorem for Ricci-pinched three-manifolds under a superquadratic volume-growth assumption. More precisely, we show that a complete connected three-manifold with convex boundary, pinched Ricci tensor, and pinched second fundamental form is isometric to the Euclidean half-space. The proof is potential-theoretic. We construct and study mixed Dirichlet--Neumann $p$-capacitary potentials, establish monotonicity formulas for their free-boundary level sets, and use a weak Gauss--Bonnet formula adapted to this setting.

analysis.workSummary: 在超二次体积增长下，研究凸边界、Ricci 张量与第二基本形式均受夹逼的完备三维流形，推出 Euclidean 半空间刚性。
analysis.breakthrough: 建立无边界 Ricci 夹逼刚性的带边界对应。
analysis.limitations: 必须保留体积增长和两种夹逼条件，摘要未列出精确常数。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
